description.value: Persia Foods is a family-owned grocery chain that has been serving Metro Vancouver's lower mainland since 1996, positioning itself as an affordable option with fresh, healthy, and ethnically diverse foods. The Kingsway location in Burnaby is one of nine stores across the region. Its multicultural product selection makes it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists looking for a wide variety of affordable provisions.
